title: Exponential backoff with jitter
hints: backoff_delay is two lines: delay = min(cap, base * 2 ** attempt); return delay + delay * jitter * rand().
Loop for attempt in range(max_attempts): call send() inside try/except OSError; a status that is not 429 or 5xx returns immediately.
Sleep only when another attempt follows: if attempt + 1 == max_attempts: break, then sleep(...) at the bottom of the loop body.

For the delay, read response.headers.get("Retry-After") and float() it when present; otherwise backoff_delay(attempt, base, cap, jitter, rand). After the loop raise RetryError(..., response=last_response, attempts=max_attempts).
